consequence.statement: GlobalContextEntry apiCall data fetches that initially fail are now retried up to 3 times by default (configurable via the new optional spec.apiCall.retryLimit field), so external-data retrieval behaves differently on transient failures; existing resources remain valid since the field is optional.
consequence.remediation: No action required; optionally set spec.apiCall.retryLimit to tune the number of retries.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 adds an optional spec.apiCall.retryLimit field (integer, minimum 1, default 3) to the v2alpha1 GlobalContextEntry CRD, providing built-in retry logic so that apiCall requests that initially fail are retried 3 times by default.
